description: This PHP source file defines the class Smarty_Template_Source, which encapsulates the data and behavior related to a template resource in Smarty. It manages template metadata, source content, resource handling, and initialization routines for template source objects.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Source
classes.description: A class representing a template resource's data in Smarty, including metadata like resource type, name, filepath, timestamp, content, and associated handlers. It facilitates loading, initialization, and retrieval of template source information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the Smarty_Template_Source object with Smarty instance, resource, type, and name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize a Smarty_Template_Source object for a given template or resource, raising an exception if the resource identifier is missing.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the template source, using the handler to populate if not already set.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the template source, either stored or retrieved via the handler.
